svg.text: Earring board (LEFT variant), part by part
Same name = joined. Red: battery, orange: 3.3 V, blue: signal.
The RIGHT board differs in two places
SD_MODE sits at 3.3 V divided by the amplifier's own 100 kΩ pulldown:
about 3.2 V with 2 kΩ (above 1.4 V: left word), about 1.0 V with 220 kΩ (0.77 – 1.4 V: right word).
SELECT to GND: the microphone answers after the clock's rising edge (left).
SELECT to 3V3: it answers after the falling edge (right).
